zh.title: 后手补偿金币 10 → 5
items: 改版后的对战记录显示后手方胜率高达约 64%——在「看完对手再行动」的更新棋盘上决策本身就约等于一个完整节奏优势，原本的 +10 起始金币属于反向过度补偿。
后手补偿下调为 +5（买兵窗口总收入：先手 110 / 后手 115），把先手/后手拉回更接近五五开。若你的买兵计划依赖后手那笔额外金币，请相应调整。

en.title: Second-mover gold bonus 10 → 5
items: Post-update records showed the second mover winning ~64% of decided matches — reacting on the already-updated board was already worth roughly a full tempo, so the +10 starting gold over-compensated.

The second-mover bonus is now +5 (buy-window income: 110 first mover / 115 second), pulling first-vs-second back toward even. If your buy plan banked on the extra second-mover gold, adjust accordingly.

zh.title: 修复：溅射/穿透的附带伤害现在也会激怒野怪
items: 此前野怪只有被「直接攻击」（作为主目标）才激怒；法师溅射、长矛穿透打到野怪只结算伤害却不激怒，导致 AoE 部队能零风险白嫖野怪赏金、野怪挨打也不还手。
现在野怪受到任何来源的伤害都会激怒——主攻击、穿透、溅射只要碰到它，就会追杀第一个伤害来源。AoE 扫过中立区不再安全，野怪真正成为「有风险的争夺资源」。

en.title: Fix: splash & pierce collateral now enrages monsters
items: Previously a monster only enraged when hit as the PRIMARY target; a mage's splash or a spear's pierce dealt damage but never woke it, letting AoE armies farm monster bounty risk-free while the monster just soaked it.

Now a monster reacts to damage from ANY source — direct hit, pierce, or splash — and hunts whoever dealt it. Lobbing AoE across the neutral band is no longer free, so monsters are genuinely a contested, risky resource.

zh.title: 陪练 bot 调整：red-charger 改为带续航的压迫流
items: 根据玩家对战记录，red-charger（原近战突脸流）胜率过低、被弓手堡垒放风筝。重做为「弓手主体 + 法师溅射 + 牧师续航 + 单骑士先锋」的压迫流：它仍向前压、惩罚冒进，但靠溅射和治疗打赢自己制造的消耗战。
对强力玩家的胜率从约 20% 提升到约 45%，定位为「有竞争力但偏下风」的练习对手——能击败弱队，但打不过顶尖高手，方便玩家上分。green-tactician、blue-turtle 本轮不变。

en.title: Practice bot tuning: red-charger reworked into a sustain-pressing doctrine
items: Player battle records showed red-charger (a melee-blitz) winning far too little — it got kited by archer fortresses. Reworked into a pressing doctrine: an archer body + a mage splash wing + priest sustain + a lone knight vanguard. It still drives forward and punishes overextension, but now wins the attrition it forces via splash and healing.

Its win rate vs strong players rose from ~20% to ~45% — positioned as a 'competitive but slight underdog' sparring partner that beats weaker armies yet loses to top play, so players can still climb. green-tactician and blue-turtle are unchanged this pass.

zh.title: 兵种平衡：弓兵射程下调 + 三个慢速单位提机动
items: 弓兵射程 4→3：长射程加稳定输出让它过早压制接近的单位，下调后弓兵必须更靠前才能输出，也更容易被近战/法师反制。
经过统一平衡测算，骑士、牧师、工兵都因为机动性偏低而「参与不进战斗」，三者一并提速：骑士移动 2→3（能追上风筝单位、扑杀后排），牧师移动 1→2（跟得上军队去奶人），工兵移动 2→3（变成廉价快速的骚扰/卡位单位）。
法师保持不变：测算显示它的「超模」是抱团团战的假象——散开站位可破溅射，再用快速单位扑杀脆皮慢速的法师即可反制，多买法师在高水平对局里反而吃亏。

en.title: Unit balance: archer range cut + mobility for three slow units
items: Archer range 4→3: long range plus steady damage let archers suppress approaching units too early. With range 3 they must commit further forward and are easier for melee/mages to contest.

A unit-balance pass found knight, priest, and engineer all too slow to take part in fights, so all three got faster: knight move 2→3 (can catch kiters and dive the backline), priest move 1→2 (keeps pace with the army to heal), engineer move 2→3 (a cheap, fast harasser/blocker).

Mage is unchanged: its apparent dominance was an artifact of clumped team-fights — dispersing denies its splash, and fast units dive the fragile, slow mage to counter it, so stacking mages actually loses in skilled play.

zh.title: 中立野怪：从「绕道躲避」改成「争夺资源」
items: 棋盘中间的中立列会刷新 8–12 只「野怪」（阵营 N），自成第三阵营，出现在 decideTurn 的 ctx.neutralUnits 字段。
野怪现在只有被「攻击」才会激怒——贴着走过去是安全的，由你决定何时开打，不再因为靠近就被缠上。
击杀野怪给击杀方 +10 金币赏金。配套经济改动：现在任意回合都能买兵，但每回合 +10 收入仍只在前 10 回合，所以 10 回合后野怪赏金就是唯一的金币来源——打野成为正经的运营策略。
激怒的野怪会追杀攻击者，但被拖离出生点超过 4 格就会放弃、回到游荡，不会一路追到你家门口；「打一下就撤」即可甩脱。
击杀野怪不计入胜负，奖励在于金币而非击杀本身。

en.title: Neutral monsters: from "detour around" to "resource to contest"
items: 8–12 neutral "monsters" (faction N) spawn in the middle columns as a third faction, exposed in decideTurn's ctx.neutralUnits.
Monsters now only enrage when ATTACKED — walking right next to one is safe, so you choose when to start the fight instead of getting latched onto by proximity.

Killing a monster pays the killer +10 gold. Paired economy change: you can now buy on any turn, but the +10/round income still stops after turn 10 — so monster bounties become your only late-game gold, making jungling a real strategy.
An enraged monster chases its attacker but gives up once kited more than 4 cells from its spawn, so it can't be dragged back to your base; poke-then-retreat cleanly drops aggro.
Killing monsters never counts toward victory — the reward is the gold, not the kill.

zh.title: 先手硬币 & 竞技场重制
items: 每局开局抛硬币决定先手方：先手方每回合先行动，后手方获得 +10 金币补偿，回放页会展示硬币结果。
竞技场界面全面重做，并重新平衡了内置 bot 与 ELO 计算。
回放页支持自动播放，并在战斗结束后自动滚动到棋盘。

en.title: First-mover coin flip & arena overhaul
items: Each match opens with a coin flip for the first mover: the winner acts first every round, the second mover gets +10 gold to compensate, and the replay page shows the result.
The arena UI was fully reworked, with rebalanced built-in bots and ELO scoring.
The replay page now autoplays and scrolls to the board after a battle.

zh.title: 被动技能 & 新兵种工兵
items: 移除主动技能系统，改为各兵种自带被动（骑士受伤减半、法师溅射、牧师治疗、长矛穿刺等）。
新增第六个兵种「工兵」。
新增平局检测：长时间毫无进展的对局会提前结束，按剩余兵力强度裁决，不再硬耗到回合上限。

en.title: Passive abilities & the new Engineer
items: The active-skill system is gone — every unit now has a built-in passive (knight half-damage, mage splash, priest heal, spear pierce, and so on).
Added a sixth unit type: the Engineer.
Added stalemate detection: matches with no progress for many turns end early and are decided on remaining army strength, instead of grinding to the turn cap.

zh.title: 经济与棋盘重做
items: 经济系统重做：用金币购买军队、攻击不再消耗行动点，购买窗口为前 10 回合。
棋盘定为 16×12，每回合固定 +10 金币收入，单位「强度」按购买成本计算。
挑战对手被限制在与自己分数 ±10% 的区间内，匹配更公平。

en.title: Economy & board redesign
items: Reworked economy: buy your army with gold, attacks no longer cost action points, and the buy window is the first 10 turns.
The board is fixed at 16×12 with a flat +10 gold/turn income, and unit "strength" is measured by purchase cost.
Challenges are restricted to opponents within ±10% of your score for fairer matchmaking.
